taskDescription: Complete the crossword using key terms from MI8.{1-2,4} | Genitourinary & Sexually Transmitted Infections. Focus on UTI etiopathogenesis, causative organisms, and specimen collection.

words.clue: Lower urinary tract infection affecting the bladder mucosa
Upper urinary tract infection involving renal pelvis and kidney parenchyma
Microbial multiplication in the urinary tract confirmed by bacterial culture
Most common route of UTI infection occurring in over 95 percent of cases
Hair-like bacterial structures that bind mannose receptors on uroepithelial cells
Blood-borne route causing renal abscess from Staphylococcus aureus bacteremia
Medical procedure conferring a 3-7 percent daily risk of bacteriuria in hospitalised patients
Incomplete bladder emptying and urinary retention predisposing to infection
Alkaline urine with stone formation caused by urease-producing Proteus bacteria
Protective matrix formation on catheter surfaces enabling antibiotic resistance in hospital-acquired UTI
Presence of glucose in urine predisposing diabetic patients to urinary tract infection
Pus or white blood cells in urine indicating urinary tract inflammation
